description:
Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.

Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
This release continues to refine the Agent experience. Mention companions by clicking their avatars or names, and view local workspace images directly in conversations. Quoted messages retain the original companion’s name, while sidebar indicators distinguish active execution, pending answers, and approval requests.
We’ve addressed long-conversation scrolling, reading-position restoration, duplicate queued messages, slow browser navigation, and compatibility with certain image-generation services. The independently updated Local Models plugin also improves local imports with manual capability selection, optimized GGUF reading, and Qwen3.5 model-structure validation.
